problem: Sign + ZK-bind + KV-cache EVERY layer of computer use (screen->browser->CLI->OS->kernel->packet) to one Solana wallet identity, then publish the ZK whitepaper 'Internal APIs Were Not All You Needed'.

nodes.title: unbrowse today: HTTP-layer fetch/resolve, browser capture, route graph, FDRY bonding paper
Identity root = Solana ed25519 wallet key; every layer's action descends from one signature
The layer stack as self-similar tree: screen-clicks > browser > CLI > OS > kernel > packet
One signed action record (who=wallet, what=op, where=layer, sig, optional ZK reveal)
Three ops per layer: effect (click/write/send), route (proxy/point-remote), query (snap/read)
ZK: prove a credential/cookie/keychain entry is bound to the wallet WITHOUT revealing it
Centralised unbrowse KV cache at each layer; sealed-unless-signed, content-addressed
No packet ships unsigned; each layer self-verifies through the wallet root before emit
Descend layers with fallback: try cheapest layer first, drop to packet only when needed; proxy to remote
Routes secured by FDRY proof-of-stake bonding (FDRY paper) + ERC-8004 trustless-agent registries
Write + gate + push 'Internal APIs Were Not All You Needed' (ZK + ERC-8004 + FDRY/PoS + CA) to Overleaf
